[Verse 1]
[B/E]Broke account, so I
broke a sweat.
[B]I've done some things that I
sort of regret about now.
[E]
[B]

[Verse 2]
[B/E]Broken glasses, but it
broke the ice.
[B]You said that I was an
asshole and I'd pay the price.
[E]
[B]

[Verse 3]
[B/E]Broken hearts want
broken necks.
[B]I've done some things that I
want to forget, but I can't.
[E]
[B]

[Verse 4]
[B/E]Broke my pace and ran
out of time.
[B]Sometimes I'm so full of shit
that it should be a crime.
[E]
[B]

[Verrse 5]
[B/E]Broken promise cuz my
car broke down.
[B]Such a classic excu-
se, it should be bronze by now.
[E]
[B]
[B/E]Broke up and I'm re-
lieved somehow.
[B]It's the end of the dis-
cussions that just go round and round...

[Chorus]
[E]And round... and round...
and round and round....
[B]and round... And round...
and shouldn't have been anyway.
[B/E]Noway, noway,
that's right, that's right.
[B]

[Outro]
[E]Uhoh, uhoh. Uh-
oh, uhohoh.
[B]Uhoh, uhoh. Uh-
oh, uhohoh.
[B/E]Uhoh, uhoh. Uh-
oh, uhohoh.
[B]It looks like everything, when
everything can go wrong.
[E]You're livin' on fancy wine.
You're drinkin' that turpentine.
[B]You're starting conversations,
you don't even knowow!
